# Set up environment

```{r, echo = FALSE, class.source = 'foldable'}
using<-function(...) {
    libs<-unlist(list(...))
    req<-unlist(lapply(libs,require,character.only=TRUE))
    need<-libs[req==FALSE]
    if(length(need)>0){ 
        install.packages(need)
        lapply(need,require,character.only=TRUE)
    }
}

# h3 from github repo
if(!require(h3)){
    remotes::install_github("crazycapivara/h3-r")
}
```

```{r, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
using("osmextract","kableExtra","ggplot2","sf","tidyverse","knitr","h3")
options(scipen = 999)
```

# Read data for 'buildings'

```{r}
library(readr)
# X86194ad37ffffff_
building_hexstats <- read_csv("csv-London-86194ad37ffffff/86194ad37ffffff-building-hexstats.csv")

# X86194ad37ffffff_
building_osm_legacy <- read_csv("csv-London-86194ad37ffffff/86194ad37ffffff-building-osm-legacy.csv")

london <- st_read("London-osm-data/geofabrik_London.gpkg")
```

```{r}
building_hexstats %>%
  select(2:ncol(.)) %>%
  arrange(desc(building_yes)) %>%
  head()
```
```{r}
h1 <- h3_to_geo_boundary_sf("8c194ad327741ff")
```

```{r}
building_osm_legacy %>%
  filter(hexid == "8c194ad327741ff")
```

```{r}
london %>%
  # collapse ids to create a unique id label
  mutate(osm_nid = case_when(is.na(osm_id) ~ osm_way_id,
                             TRUE ~ osm_id)) %>%
  filter(osm_nid %in% c(2023676, 150143253, 150143254, 150143256, 150143259, 319342619)) %>%
  select(osm_nid, name) %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_sf(alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_sf(data = h1, alpha = 0, col="tomato") +
  theme_void() +
  labs(title = "National Theatre")
```

```{r}
london %>%
  # collapse ids to create a unique id label
  mutate(osm_nid = case_when(is.na(osm_id) ~ osm_way_id,
                             TRUE ~ osm_id)) %>%
  filter(osm_nid %in% c(2023676, 150143253, 150143254, 150143256, 150143259, 319342619)) %>%
  select(osm_nid) %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_sf() +
  theme_void() +
  facet_wrap(~osm_nid)
```
